en: Vintage tinted photographic postcard showing a panoramic view of the alpine town of Predazzo set in a narrow valley between steep, forested mountains. In the foreground are clustered buildings with light façades and tiled roofs; a tall church with a slender spire dominates the town center. In the background, high mountain peaks (the Dolomites) rise above layered ridges. There is cursive handwriting in ink across the top margin, and printed caption text along the bottom reading about Predazzo and Cimon della Pala.
